## **Homework**

You have a set of 4 .csv files in `data/homework`. Each file is a timeseries of temperature and light data collected in tide pools in Oregon by Jenn Fields. Bring in all 4 files and calculate the mean and standard deviation of both temperature (**Temp.C**) and light (**Intensity.lux**) for each tide pool.

Do this twice, once using the for loop function and once using the map() function.

First, add libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

Next, bring in all four files using a loop

```{r}
# List files in a directory
# Point to the folder on the computer
HWPath <- here("Week_13", "data", "homework")

# List all files in that path matching a pattern (here, anything with .csv)
# You can use regex to be more specific about filenames
files <- dir(path = HWPath, pattern = ".csv")

files
```

Pre-allocate space for the loop

```{r}
# Calculcate the mean temp and salinity for each file
# One row for each file and 3 columns
temp_light <- tibble(filename = rep(NA, length(files)), # 3 files, so we want 3 rows
                    mean_temp = rep(NA, length(files)),
                    sd_temp = rep(NA, length(files)),
                    mean_light = rep(NA, length(files)),
                    sd_light = rep(NA, length(files)))

temp_light
```

Write the basic code first

```{r}
# Test by reading in the first file
raw_data <- read_csv(paste0(HWPath, "/", files[1]))
head(raw_data)

mean_temp <- mean(raw_data$Temp.C, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_temp
```

Turn it into a loop

```{r}

# Add in the loop over the raw data
for (i in seq_along(files)) {
  
  raw_data <- read_csv(paste0(HWPath, "/", files[i]))
  glimpse(raw_data)
  
}
```

Add in the columns

```{r}
# Add in the columns
for (i in seq_along(files)) {
  
  raw_data <- read_csv(paste0(HWPath, "/", files[i]))
  
  temp_light$filename[i] <- files[i]
  
}

temp_light
```

Add in means and SD

```{r}
# Add in means
for (i in seq_along(files)) {
  
  raw_data <- read_csv(paste0(HWPath, "/", files[i]))
  
  temp_light$filename[i] <- files[i]
  temp_light$mean_temp[i] <- mean(raw_data$Temp.C, na.rm = TRUE)
  temp_light$sd_temp[i] <- sd(raw_data$Temp.C, na.rm = TRUE)
  temp_light$mean_light[i] <- mean(raw_data$Intensity.lux, na.rm = TRUE)
  temp_light$sd_light[i] <- sd(raw_data$Intensity.lux, na.rm = TRUE)
}

temp_light
```

**Repeat using purrr**

Get the file names

```{r}
# Or get the full file names in one less step
files2 <- dir(path = HWPath, pattern = ".csv", full.names = TRUE) # saves the entire path
files2
```

Read in the files

```{r}
data <- files2 |>
  set_names() |> # names each list element with its file name
  map(read_csv) |> # a list of 3 dataframes
  list_rbind(names_to = "filename") # stack them; list names go in a "filename" column

data
```

Calculate means and SD

```{r}
# Calculate means
data <- files2 |>
  set_names() |>
  map(read_csv) |>
  list_rbind(names_to = "filename") |>
  group_by(filename) |>
  summarise(mean_temp = mean(Temp.C, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_temp = sd(Temp.C, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_light = mean(Intensity.lux, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_light = sd(Intensity.lux, na.rm = TRUE))

data
```
